verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy is a payments platform and merchant of record, so handling disputes through an API is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no dispute endpoints for retrieving disputes, submitting evidence, or sending responses. The merchant-of-record claim that it handles fraud is adjacent and does not show that an agent can work a dispute end-to-end via the API.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API
